_about: Public-domain James Strahan, Presbyterian Old Testament scholar, for the Word Hoard: Hebrew Ideals, The Captivity and the Pastoral Epistles, The Book of Job Interpreted, and his life of Andrew Bruce Davidson. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 131 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

strahan-hebrew-ideals: Hebrew ideals; a study of Genesis from chap. XI. to L (Edinburgh, T. & T. Clark, 1915)
strahan-captivity-pastoral: The captivity and the pastoral epistles (New York : Fleming H. Revell, [191)
strahan-book-of-job: The book of Job interpreted (Edinburgh T. & T. Clark, 1914)
strahan-a-b-davidson: Andrew Bruce Davidson (London : Hodder and Stoughton, 1917)

_excluded.strahan-law: the law books are by James Andrew Strahan, a barrister
_excluded.strahan-others: the Maréchale and Mary Crawford Brown biographies: not certain they are by the same James Strahan
_excluded.strahan-dups: the 1902 and 1906 editions of Hebrew Ideals
